pages.text: Air is Core's ambient estimate. Feels like includes wind, wetness, room, radiant warmth, cooling and immersion. Body is your physiological state and changes gradually.

pages.title: Body readings
pages.text: 37 °C is normal body temperature. Below 36.6 °C is cold; below 35 °C dangerous hypothermia. Above 37.5 °C is warm, from 39.5 °C dangerous overheating. Apparent temperature is not body temperature.

pages.title: Frostbite
pages.text: Frostbite is separate limb injury. Unprotected at −15 °C it takes about 5 minutes, −28 °C 2 minutes, −40 °C 75 seconds. Wind, wetness and clothing modify risk. These are game values.
Snow does not create heat; it retains it. Air can be above zero during a thaw. Core defines regional temperature; Thermal computes exposure.
